# Toolchain for building the Gloopy manual (see documentation-strategy).
# Everything except the four reference generators, which run in CI (docs.yml).
#
#   python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r requirements-docs.txt
#   mkdocs serve

mkdocs-material>=9.5
mkdocstrings[python]>=0.25
mike>=2.1

# gRPC reference is generated by `buf generate` (protoc-gen-doc) in CI — not pip.
# OSC reference is generated by our own Jinja script (tools/osc-docs.py) — CI.
# Common Lisp reference is generated by 40ants-doc from the Lisp client — CI.
# Printable user-guide PDF (strategy §7):
mkdocs-with-pdf>=0.9
jinja2>=3.1        # OSC reference generator
